name: Linnik class bounds for $s(m-2^\nu)$ via odd squarefree moduli
description:
This mission concerns arithmetic weights attached to differences between an integer and powers of two. For a nonzero integer $h$, the singular factor $s(h)$ is the finite product of $1+1/(p-2)$ over odd primes dividing $h$. The auxiliary weight $k(d)$ is supported on odd squarefree integers, and $\xi(d)$ records the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $d$. The exponent range is $1\le\nu\le L$, and zero differences are excluded.

The target is a uniform bound for sums of $s(m-2^\nu)$ subject to $r\mid C(m-2^\nu)$. For every $\eta>0$, sufficiently large $L$ and a sufficiently large odd squarefree part $r^\prime$ relative to $C$ give an upper bound $\eta L$, uniformly for integers $m$ with $|m|\le2^{2L}$. Such estimates control contributions from exceptional arithmetic classes in problems involving primes and powers of two. Binary Goldbach remains open.

The source is J. Pintz and I. Z. Ruzsa, [On Linnik's approximation to Goldbach's problem. II](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10474-020-01077-8), Acta Mathematica Hungarica, 2020. The relevant material is Lemma 1 and displays $2.34$ through $2.40$, together with the class restriction in display $4.3$. The lab states a general form allowing negative $m$ and all nonzero differences; this scope is preserved here.

AI wrote these Lean statements in an AI-run Lean lab. This is a draft for Steve's human audit before submission to Prove2Me; the required human audit is pending. The sixteen open leaves and final assembly are presented as proof obligations. Compilation with admitted proofs checks their syntax and types, without establishing their truth.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1537a

open Finset Real

noncomputable def kf (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Odd d ∧ Squarefree d then ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 2) else 0

end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For $d\in\mathbb N$, define $k(d)=\prod_{p\mid d}1/(p-2)$ if $d$ is odd and squarefree, and $k(d)=0$ otherwise.

items.definition_title: Order of two modulo a natural number
items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1537a

open Finset Real

noncomputable def xi (d : ℕ) : ℕ := orderOf (2 : ZMod d)

end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For $d\in\mathbb N$, define $\xi(d)$ as the multiplicative order of $2$ in $\mathbb Z/d\mathbb Z$, using the Lean order convention of zero when the order is infinite.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1537a

open Finset Real

noncomputable def sfac (h : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ p ∈ h.natAbs.primeFactors.filter (fun p => 2 < p), (1 + 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 2))

end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For $h\in\mathbb Z$, define $s(h)=\prod_{p\mid |h|,\ p>2}(1+1/(p-2))$, with the product over the prime factors of $|h|$ as implemented by Lean.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1537a

open Finset Real

def oddSqf (r : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ r.primeFactors.filter (fun p => 2 < p), p

end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For $r\in\mathbb N$, define its odd squarefree part $r^\prime=\prod_{p\mid r,\ p>2}p$, using Lean prime factors also when $r=0$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1537a

open Finset Real

def qOf (r C : ℕ) : ℕ := oddSqf r / Nat.gcd (oddSqf r) C

end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For $r,C\in\mathbb N$, define $q(r,C)=r^\prime/\gcd(r^\prime,C)$ by natural number division.

items.theorem_title: Divisor expansion of the singular factor
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1537a
theorem sfac_eq_sum_kf (h : ℤ) (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    sfac h = ∑ d ∈ h.natAbs.divisors, kf d := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For every nonzero integer $h$, one has $s(h)=\sum_{d\mid |h|}k(d)$, where the divisors are positive.

items.theorem_title: Splitting the least common multiple order sum
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1537a
theorem sum_div_xi_lcm_le {q : ℕ} (hq : Odd q) (D : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ s, kf d / (xi (Nat.lcm d q) : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ d ∈ range (D + 1), kf d) / xi q + ∑ d ∈ s.filter (fun d => D < d), kf d / xi d := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1537a
items.natural_language_statement: For every odd $q\in\mathbb N$, cutoff $D\in\mathbb N$, and finite $S\subset\mathbb N$, $\sum_{d\in S}k(d)/\xi(\operatorname{lcm}(d,q))\le (\sum_{d=0}^{D}k(d))/\xi(q)+\sum_{d\in S,\ d>D}k(d)/\xi(d)$.
